column1: # A counted array [Min..Max]T below its minimum is refused on every read
# (F-203; docs/SPEC.md 5.1 row 3; docs/SPEC-TABLES.md 3.3, 3.4), as one past
# the bound is. The reader is reader.schema ([2..4]); the bytes are the Go
# engine's encoding of value under writer.schema ([..4]), except on the fixed
# form, where they are the reader's own layout and forge rewrites the count
# word in place. Each refused row sits beside its lawful twin at the minimum.
